'''Death Star II''' is the 25th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher on 19 July 2000. It is 182 cards (91 Light Side and 91 Dark Side): 2 ultra rares ([[Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]] and [[Emperor Palpatine]]), 78 rares, 50 uncommons, 50 commons, and 2 exclusive rares packed only in starters ([[Admiral Ackbar]] and [[Admiral Piett]]). Black border. CardGuide numbering: 25th product.

It covers the Battle of Endor and the second Death Star. Sold in 11-card packs (MSRP $3.29: 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare or ultra rare) in 36-pack boxes, and in 60-card starter decks (MSRP $10.95; 12 decks per box, 6 per side). Starter decks also include 55 reprint fixed cards with a 2000 copyright. See [[Death Star II Starter Decks]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Death Star II's reverse is the expansion card list plus a pre-constructed deck list.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:DS2-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|360px|Death Star II four-panel poster front]]
[[File:DS2-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|360px|Death Star II four-panel poster reverse]]

== Print sheets ==
Rares, uncommons, commons, and preconstructed-deck sheets are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Ultra rares appear twice per rare sheet; most rares three times, with four titles four times ([[Strike Planning]], [[You Must Confront Vader]], [[Flagship Operations]], [[That Thing's Operational]]). Each precon sheet held two 60-card decks plus one blank black card.<ref name="encyc" />
